title: Analyze Java method body regions before monolithic-method extraction
wanted_capability: A Java method-body region analyzer that partitions a long method into concern-labelled contiguous regions and reports read-before locals, live-out locals, field reads/writes, listener/lambda captures, early exits, and region contiguity before a transform is attempted.
fallback_used: The probe manually read method slices and classified region boundaries, locals, and captures before trying the transform.
notes: Generic finding from a private long-method probe. The core cost was manual region/contiguity/live-out analysis before extract_java_code_block_to_method.
resolution_note: Implemented syntax-only Java method-body region analysis as bbox_refactor::analyze_java_method_regions plus code-mode analysis.methodRegions({ file, method, className?, ranges? }). It reports top-level statement regions and requested candidate ranges with captures, live-outs, field touches, lambda/listener counts, non-local control flow, and extractability stop reasons so probes can run contiguity/live-out gates before mutation.
